name: Articles (a / an / the / zero)
note: Use a/an with a singular countable noun mentioned for the first time (a before a consonant sound, an before a vowel sound). Use the when it is clear which one you mean, or it is unique. Use no article for plural or uncountable nouns in general (I like music), and most names.
